svg.title: The outgoing scattering amplitude sets an effective cross section
svg.desc: A meridional section of an isotropic three-dimensional Born scattering state. The incident direction is positive z. Blue parallel lines are equal-phase incident plane-wave fronts. Teal circles are equal-phase outgoing spherical-wave fronts with spacing lambda, the same as the plane fronts. The scatterer is at the labeled origin. A dashed radial coordinate and angle theta are coordinates, not particle paths. The chosen amplitude is f_sc=-a_B, so the differential cross section is a_B squared and the total is4pi a_B squared. With impurity density10^22 per cubic metre, speed10^5m/s and total cross section10^-18m squared, the event rate is10^9 per second and the waiting time is1ns.
svg.text: Scattering amplitude, cross section and event rate
